subject.title: Google Chat: markdown renders as raw text; typing indicator says 'OpenClaw is typing' instead of app name

question: Should Google Chat convert assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported markup, strip unsupported Markdown to plain text, or keep current markdown-capable behavior and narrow this issue to the typing-name bug?
rationale: Current source marks Google Chat as markdown-capable and official Google Chat docs support a limited markdown dialect, while the issue asks to strip or convert raw assistant Markdown; automation should not choose the permanent channel rendering policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Convert supported markup
options.body: Implement a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported syntax, strips unsupported markers, and also adds the `identity.name` typing fallback.

options.title: Plain text only
options.body: Treat Google Chat as a plain-text channel, strip Markdown before delivery, and update metadata/docs/tests to remove the current markdown-capable contract.

options.title: Typing fix only
options.body: Land only the `identity.name` typing fallback and document that Google Chat currently receives markdown-capable text without full dialect conversion.

recommendation.title: Convert supported markup
recommendation.body: Implement a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported syntax, strips unsupported markers, and also adds the `identity.name` typing fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current routing signal from Google Chat polish, reply-delivery refactor, and shortlog history on the affected files.
